title: V5.1固定50期真实前瞻验证

reference_lock.rule: Use the unique, hash-verified 1251 lock as the frozen model configuration reference.

random_control.ticket_count_rule: Must equal the model ticket count and be a positive integer for each target draw.

primary_endpoint.name: mean_hits_difference_per_ticket
primary_endpoint.definition: Per target draw: V5.1 mean hits per ticket minus the same-draw uniform-random control mean hits per ticket.

inference.method: percentile bootstrap over target-draw paired differences
inference.timing: Run only after all 50 unique target draws have been scored.

secondary_endpoints_descriptive_only: Brier score versus the uniform marginal probability 6/45
Log Loss versus the uniform marginal probability 6/45
protocol_guards: Exactly one forward-lock event per target draw.
If a target draw has multiple lock events, exclude all records for that target; never select the best-performing one.
Require one unique 1251 reference lock and identical frozen model configuration fields across all 50 target draws.
Require equal, positive integer ticket counts for model and random control on every draw.
Do not stop early, tune parameters, or change the model during the fixed window.
Show only descriptive summaries before all 50 draws are complete; do not issue interim significance claims.
data_policy: Only user-manually-imported historical CSV/Excel data. No official lottery website, API, scraping, third-party results feed, or automatic draw synchronization.
interpretation_boundary: This protocol evaluates a pre-specified model against a same-draw random control. It does not imply improved future winning probability unless the locked prospective results support that conclusion.
